changeSet.author: jordi.jaspers
changeSet.comment: Create subscription table for watchlist-level user subscriptions.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS subscription ( id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, watchlist_id INTEGER NOT NULL, target_severities JSONB NOT NULL, adapters JSONB NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (watchlist_id) REFERENCES watchlist(id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
